preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of cities n in each test case must be between 2 and 3000.
The total number of cities across all test cases must not exceed 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two valid cities within the range from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company.

postconditions.expression: len(c) == n - 1 and all(1 <= c_i <= 10**6 for c_i in c)
postconditions.description: The output must contain n-1 company assignments, each between 1 and 10^6.
Each company must repair roads for at most two different cities.
